###Strategy

Let's use the data in the graph to find how much range is gained from $1$ minute of charging. Then, we can write an equation to find how many kilometers of range the bicycle gains ($k$) based on how many minutes it charges ($t$).

###Unit rate and equation

[[☃ image 1]]

$t$ | $1$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div5}$ | $5$ | $10$ | $15$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -: | -:
$k$ | $4$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div5}$ | $20$ | $40$ | $60$

The electric bicycle gains $4\,\text{km}$ of range for every $1$ minute of charging, so we can write an equation to find how many kilometers of range the bicycle gains ($k$) for any number of minutes it charges ($t$):

$k=4t$
